arguments.title: parseCertificateList refuses a delta CRL with an empty revokedCertificates list
arguments.summary: A delta CRL (deltaCRLIndicator present) whose revokedCertificates SEQUENCE is absent is refused with PKI_X509_STRUCTURE_INVALID although RFC 5280 makes the field OPTIONAL.
arguments.expectedBehavior: The delta CRL parses with entryCount 0.
